name: Scrut
summary: Scrut says it supports more than 70 frameworks, including SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and maps common controls between the two so one control can serve both audits. Auditors join a specific audit with read-only, scoped access. Pricing is a custom quote with no user or usage limits.

evidence.capability: framework templates such as soc 2 and iso 27001

facts.text: Scrut's FAQ says auditors are never granted unrestricted access. They join a specific audit's team and get read-only, scoped access to what they need.
The FAQ says Scrut integrates with over 80 tools to collect audit-ready evidence automatically, while the home page cites more than 150 integrations.
Scrut maintains a unified control library that automatically maps common controls between SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
The FAQ says plans carry no limits or hidden charges based on users or usage, and that audit charges may influence the final quote.
Home page: the Evidence Collector pulls evidence from AWS, GitHub and Okta. The dedicated pricing URL returned an error on the day of checking.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.notes: No user or usage limits. Request through the demo page

hiddenCosts: Additional services such as audit charges may influence the final quote.
